description: Create house.room_value, a materialized rollup of what each room holds.
rationale: Stale by design: this is a household inventory, and 'what is the study worth' does not need to be true to the second. The unique index REFRESH ... CONCURRENTLY needs is a separate specification, 0064, because a plan is measured against the catalog and the matview does not exist there until this one has committed.

intents.name: room_value
intents.comment: Item count and total value per room, as of the last REFRESH. Refresh it CONCURRENTLY; room_value_room_id_key exists to make that legal.
intents.definition: SELECT r.room_id, r.name AS room_name, r.kind AS room_kind, count(i.item_id) AS item_count, COALESCE(sum(i.purchase_price), 0) AS purchase_total, COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(i.current_price, i.purchase_price)), 0) AS current_total FROM house.room AS r LEFT JOIN house.item AS i ON i.room_id = r.room_id GROUP BY r.room_id, r.name, r.kind
